responsibility: Implements LRA rematerialization of spilled pseudo values. It identifies rematerialization candidate insns with cheap, memory-free computations, computes partial and full availability of those candidates across the CFG, and replaces reloads of spilled pseudos with regenerated instruction sequences when the original value can be safely recomputed at use sites. The pass is an optimization within the LRA iteration intended to reduce reload traffic before committing spills to memory.
